Name: Faust Portrait
Author: Reginleafy
Description:
Portraits I made for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37246]Faust [/url]﻿because I like this gloomy lil guy :>

This is my first attempt at portraits so please let me know if you encounter any issues, any feedback in general is also appreciated!

[b]!! IMPORTANT: You need portraiture for these to work, as well as portraitureplus for the winter portraits !![/b]

How to Install:
[list=1]
[*]If you don't already have them, download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ mod, as well as the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url]﻿ mod.
[*]Download this mod! (thank you)
[*]Go to Mods/Portraiture/Portraits and create a new folder (you can name if whatever you like but I usually name it after the character to make things simple).
[*]Copy the portraits from this mod into the new folder.
[*]When you talk to Faust in game, press M to open the Portraiture menu, scroll until you find his portraits and click on them. When you exit the menu he should have his new portraits! :D
[*](Bonus) Press O so that his new portrait displays whenever you talk to him.
[/list]
Thank you so much again to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/SukuroIsUseless]SukuroIsUseless[/url] for making Faust!

(and a special thank you to the fire emblem 3h soundtrack for helping me lock in while I worked on this lol)
